REVISE

- **Check 2 | Preset vs. Visual Spec Color Contradiction**: The visual specification explicitly states "knockout text on ink blocks `#fff0f6`" (primary.50, a magenta-tinted white), but elements/preset.ts defines `knockout.base: '{colors.neutral.50}'`, which resolves to `#fbf3f6` (a plum-tinted white). The preset's knockout should be `{colors.primary.50}` to match the spec. This matters because knockout text on the dark ink panels (#150a0f) needs to be the brightest, warmest off-white for legibility against the fluoro field.
